mapper.insert: insert into comment( id, article_id, content, created, user_id ) values ( #{id}, #{articleId}, #{content}, #{timeStamp}, #{userId} )
mapper.select: select id,content, user_id as userId, article_id as articleId from comment where id = #{id}
